question: Why is this visarga called the principle of Kama in the Kula teaching?
premises: This visarga consists of the unmanifest letters ha and ka.
Because of that nature it receives a specific doctrinal name.
In the revered Kula cave it is called the principle of Kama.
inference: The unmanifest ha-ka nature of visarga is identified as the Kama principle in Kula doctrine.
uncertainties: The compound śrīmatkulaguhvara is read as a locative doctrinal reference.
plain_english: Therefore this visarga, consisting of the unmanifest ha and ka, is called the principle of Kama in the revered Kula cave.
